name: How do I choose the right contractor for my Junior ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my Junior ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful Junior ADU project. Look for a general contractor with extensive experience specifically in ADU and JADU construction in your local area. Request to see a portfolio of their completed projects and ask for references from previous clients. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and have a clear understanding of local zoning laws and building codes. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, a clear timeline, and open communication throughout the entire process, from design to final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU/JADU experience, check licenses, insurance, and references, and ensure they understand local codes and provide clear proposals.
